name: Alisoun Neville
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I’m Alisoun, a Creative Arts and Somatic Therapist in Melbourne. I have learned through life experience and formal study to use creative expression, embodiment, and inquiry as powerful guides through some of life’s complex and difficult matters. I work with both children and adults, adopting a collaborative approach and offering 'more-than-verbal' methods for communication, exploration, and understanding.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing

name: David Mutton
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a practicing psychologist and psychotherapist. I am both a graduate of the Gestalt Institute of Melbourne and the Gestalt Training Center of San Diego and and have trained in, and work with a variety of modalities. Key to my work is a client centred approach and adjusting helping and psychotherapeutic strategies to work with clients, their life stages, key projects and developmental needs and aspirations.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Seko Chai Ong
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Seko Ong has spent over 30 years focusing on education that emphasizes human values and motivation. As a Life Coach and Psychotherapist, she is committed to guiding people toward inner transformation. She helps individuals uncover their creative, courageous, and compassionate selves, promoting a hopeful way of living.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Amanda McKay
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Highly trained professional Psychotherapist, Clinical Hypnotherapist and Art Therapist; Amanda McKay can assist you with a wide range of concerns. Amanda does not make any judgment or make decisions for you. She helps people understand the psychological landscape in an easily accessible way and to acknowledge and make space for the different parts of self that in this human experience are so often the source of inner conflict.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing

name: Susan Dawson
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: My approach supports your uniqueness and the energy of who you truly are. Recent body-mind research indicates that it is in a safe and supportive relationship, that change can happen. At Emotional WellBeing Centre (EWC) I offer you a safe, non judgemental, respectful and intersubjective alliance, in which we explore what is happening for you and what you would like to have instead.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Sherridan Green
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Sherridan is a Gestalt therapist | EMDR therapist | clinical counsellor in private practice for 15 years working with Couples and Individuals. EMDR – Eye movement desensitization and reprocessing therapy is a mental health treatment technique. This method involves moving your eyes a specific way while you process traumatic memories. EMDR’s goal is to help you heal from trauma or other distressing life experiences. A concern/s can be anything including depression, anxiety, anger, sadness, confusion, stress, loss, grief, overwhelm, sexuality, life direction, live-work balance, relationships, lack of purpose, confidence, perspective, emotional insecurity etc.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery
